implementation: production Kotlin compiled from source with real Android SQLite
cases: SELECT-only transaction exports exact committed snapshot
new-package import retains every opaque record byte and marker
binding authorization cannot cover another gameplay payload
failed transaction preserves existing world exactly
retry imports one absolute snapshot without additive rewards
corrupt source file preserved byte exactly
failed import does not delete or rewrite corrupt destination
identity lookup does not delete corrupt save
corrupt fixture failure cannot affect another valid destination
transfer blocked while game lifetime lock is held
preparation freeze visible to game frame/input gate
duplicate preparation cannot start another checkpoint
failed or cancelled preparation releases gameplay freeze
limitations: Opaque synthetic payloads are not loadable game farms.
This is not an actual old-APK SAF export/new-APK import/UI validation.
Same-process overlapping-lock test; not a long concurrent-process restart stress test.
